Also we need to know the endpoint: For VirusTotal v3, the endpoint for voting is POST /ip_addresses/{ip_address}/votes. The request body includes type and attributes. So we need to send a request to https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes with the JSON body. The user provided the JSON. We need to include the API key in the header: x-apikey: <key>. So we need to ask for the key. The user said "With my 'key_four'". Maybe they have a key named key_four. We can ask them to provide the key. Or we can ask them to confirm the key. We should not reveal any sensitive info.
